title: Developer Support Engineer
description:
At JFrog, we're reinventing DevSecOps to help the world's greatest companies innovate. Our team of industry-leading software security experts is a true pioneer, constantly pushing the boundaries with original research and technological innovation. JFrog is a special place with a unique combination of brilliance, spirit, and just all-around great people. Thousands of customers, including the majority of the Fortune 100, trust JFrog to manage, accelerate, and secure their software delivery from code to production – a concept we call "liquid software". Wouldn't it be amazing if you could join us on our journey?  
  
We are looking for top-notch Developer Support Engineers, to be partners rather than just employees and be the technical focal point for JFrog customers.

##### **As a Developer Support Engineer at JFrog you will...**

* Troubleshoot and investigate complex customer CI/CD scenarios and provide innovative solutions for their requirements
* Develop scripts in Bash, Python, and Groovy for debugging and automating
* Set up JFrog applications and 3rd party products in various development environments
* Analyze log files, thread dumps, HTTP traffic, JVM and OS parameters
* Reproduce customer scenarios and fill relevant bugs/features
* Maintain and improve a knowledge base of known issues and solutions
* Integrate and collaborate with JFrog's R&D, QA, Release and Sales teams
* Availability to work flexible hours and weekends when needed

##### **To be a Developer Support Engineer at JFrog you need…**

* B.Sc. or equivalent in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field
* 2+ years of hands-on experience in technical roles (e.g., Tier 3 Support, NOC, Production Engineer, or Junior DevOps/SRE)
* Proven ability to manage complex, escalated cases involving multiple architectures across multiple platforms
* Deep experience in Linux (Systems Administration, Bash scripting, file systems).
* Strong technical software-related debugging skills (Log analysis, root cause analysis, stack trace reading)
* Ability to read and debug code in Java or another compiled language
* Excellent spoken and written English
* Knowledge/experience with: Databases (SQL), LDAP, NGINX, Apache Tomcat
* Familiarity with the modern DevOps stack and lifecycle, including experience with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions), Containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), Cloud Infrastructure (AWS/Azure), and IaC (Terraform)
* Graduate of an advanced DevOps certification program

title: Data Analyst – Automotive Lighting Systems - Temporary position for 9 months
description:
Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology, data-driven decision making, and making a real impact on road safety?

Join our innovative team and help power the next generation of smart automotive lighting systems.

As a Data Analyst on the team, you will evaluate the performance of the technology that decides how millions of vehicles light the road at night.

You will analyze large-scale night-drive data, investigate system behavior, generate actionable insights, and develop tools that improve analysis processes and operational efficiency.

You will work closely with algorithm developers, software engineers, and product teams to ensure high reliability, strong data quality, and scalable workflows, and to make sure our performance holds up in real world and regulatory scenarios.

This role includes designing solutions and AI-driven tools that help streamline processes, reduce manual work, and improve the productivity of our analysis and data production environment.

The role also requires conducting in-depth investigations developing AI-powered analysis tools, extracting actionable insights from complex data, and translating these findings into recommendations that drive improvements in our technology and products.

  

**Temporary position for 9 months**

### **What will your job look like:**

* Analyze large-scale night-driving datasets to evaluate the performance of our lighting technology, own and evolve the KPI picture, false-positive and false-negative rates, mean time and distance between false events, over a labeled scene catalog spanning countries, road types and weather conditions.
* Investigate complex issues down to a specific frame, light source or classifier decision, identify root causes, and provide actionable insights to the algorithm and software teams.
* Develop AI-powered tools and automation solutions to improve analysis efficiency and shorten the path from a failed drive to an understood root cause.
* Support product and algorithmic decisions through data-driven analysis, including regression analysis between versions and validation of new developments before release.
* Define and refine the data we need: labeling requests, scenario coverage, and edge cases, and monitor the quality of what comes back.
* Collaborate with algorithm, software, research and product teams to validate new developments and verify regulatory scenarios.
* Present findings and recommendations through clear reports, dashboards and summaries.

### **All you need is:**

* B.Sc. in Industrial Engineering, Data Science, mathematics, physics etc.
* 2+ years of experience in data analysis, research, or a similar analytical role
* Strong technical ability, and scripting abilities
* Experience in using AI tools
* Fluent English.
* Hands-on experience with Python - an advantage.
* Familiarity with AI tools, machine learning concepts, or data-driven technologies - an advantage.
* Experience analyzing perception, computer vision, or sensor-based systems - an advantage.

title: Junior CAD Engineer, University Graduate, Google Cloud
description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Tel Aviv, Israel; Haifa, Israel**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience with coding and scripting (e.g. Perl, TCL, or Python), or similar.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 1 year of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, and with data structures and algorithms.
* 1 year of experience building developer tools that improve developer velocity, code quality and code health (e.g., compilers, automated).
* 1 year of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products.

**About the job**
-----------------

Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct-to-consumer products. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration.

As a CAD Engineer, you will drive the architecture, development, and optimization of hardware design flows and infrastructure. You will collaborate with silicon design, verification, and architecture teams to build robust front-end CAD tooling, automated workflows and continuous integration/presubmit frameworks. In this role, you will address complex hardware design technology challenges, streamline CAD workflows for high-impact silicon projects, and ensure high quality and scalability across global engineering teams.

The ML, Systems, & Cloud AI (MSCA) organization at Google designs, implements, and manages the hardware, software, machine learning, and systems infrastructure for all Google services (Search, YouTube, etc.) and Google Cloud. Our end users are Googlers, Cloud customers and the billions of people who use Google services around the world.

We prioritize security, efficiency, and reliability across everything we do - from developing our latest TPUs to running a global network, while driving towards shaping the future of hyperscale computing. Our global impact spans software and hardware, including Google Cloud’s Vertex AI, the leading AI platform for bringing Gemini models to enterprise customers.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Work with partner teams to provide the compute, storage and methodology needs of the chip design, verification and physical design teams.
* Design and implement CAD tools, solutions and methodologies for ASIC development.
* Create software solutions that improve the hardware design process through automation.
* Propose, design and implement software automation that directly addresses bottlenecks in today's ASIC and SoC EDA flow.
* Leverage AI to both speed the development of tools and development flows, providing more natural and higher-efficiency ways for users to interact with developed technologies.
